transcript: Last night my boyfriend Paul and I went to see The Harder They Come at the public, a new musical adaptation of the 1972 film of the same name. It follows a man named Ivan who moves from the Jamaican countryside to the city of Kingston to start a new life and follow his dreams of being a musician. I haven't seen the film, but I really loved the musical. The music is super catchy and the performances are great. I was absolutely blown away by everyone's voices. If you can get tickets before it closes on April 9th, I would highly recommend without another play, vote for my collection.
